### VoiceStudio

Fully local, open-source ElevenLabs alternative for voice cloning, voice design, dubbing, dictation, transcription and audiobooks in 646 languages. Ships a desktop app (Electron/Tauri), model manager, local API and an MCP server for agent integration.
